podcast.body: "Thunder" by Imagine Dragons, released in 2017, was declared the absolute number one song of the 2010s by Billboard, based on their various metrics. It was also one of only four rock songs to appear in Spotify's top 100 most streamed songs of the decade. "According to Billboard and all the metrics they use, this was the absolute number one song of the 2010s. That's from 2017. And that's Imagine Dragons. Again."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 5: Music and Tech
